我的朋友妮娜(My Friend Nina): 围绕职场工作的A1短文:介绍大卫的日常、喜好与前台。
David usually eats fish for lunch. We often go to the gym together. I like my life very much. The shop knows every customer by name.
I am happy every day. The front desk is not far from my home. After school, we play together. Best of all, he started a small company last year.
My friend Nina is very kind. David's favorite subject is music. Nina often helps me with music.
